attributions.description: The placement subplan repeated navigation and opening despite the immediately preceding successful opening and no intervening action.

result.reasoning: The robot turned off the living-room lamp at a1. Explore timed out at a2, a3, and a6. The first timeout still yielded observations of both toys and the dirty plate, but the updated goals kept hypothetical dish IDs. For each truck pickup, the planner navigated to the room floor and then failed the reach check. It repeated that approach until the run stopped at 1201 seconds.

attributions.evidence: Explore[living_room_1] returned 'Skill took too long to finish' at a2, a3, and a6.
attributions.description: Three Explore calls consumed time and failed to complete the room inspection, contributing to the episode timeout.

attributions.evidence: After a2 revealed both toys and the dirty plate, Decision 3 repeated EXPLORE living_room_1. Decisions 6 through 8 repeated PICK toy_truck_0 floor_living_room_1 after the first reach failure.
attributions.description: The planner spent the remaining run on broad exploration and the same unsuccessful pickup approach while other task goals were pending.

attributions.evidence: Decision 4 selected (PICK toy_truck_0 floor_living_room_1). Navigate reported success, but Pick said 'Not close enough to the object.'
attributions.description: The pickup plan used the truck's parent area as its approach target. That navigation left the truck outside pickup range.

attributions.evidence: Decision 6 reused (PICK toy_truck_0 floor_living_room_1) after Decision 4 failed the reach check. The same proximity error returned at a8.
attributions.description: The second pickup inherited the original approach, whose navigation target had already failed to put the truck within reach.

attributions.evidence: Decision 7 again used (PICK toy_truck_0 floor_living_room_1). Navigate succeeded at a9 and Pick again returned 'Not close enough to the object' at a10.
attributions.description: The third pickup reused the original floor target, leaving the reach precondition unmet again.

attributions.evidence: After a2 timed out, its observation listed stuffed_toy_0 on couch_0, toy_truck_0 on floor_living_room_1, and dirty plate_0 on cabinet_5. Decision 3 immediately repeated EXPLORE living_room_1.
attributions.description: The planner repeated the full-room search after the first call had already supplied concrete targets it could act on. The retry revealed no new objects.

attributions.evidence: After a5 reported 'Not close enough to the object,' Decisions 6 and 7 selected the same truck pickup with the same floor navigation target.
attributions.description: The planner repeated the failed sequence without changing the navigation target or switching to another task goal.

result.reasoning: The robot switched off both lights and stored the stuffed toy by a10. It had already located the dirty plate and the toy truck, but the updated goals omitted the truck and still included hypothetical toys. Explore timed out four times, and the planner launched a fifth attempt without attempting to wash or store the plate.

attributions.evidence: Explore[living_room_1] returned 'Skill took too long to finish' at a11–a14. The episode timed out during the fifth attempt at a15.
attributions.description: The Explore skill repeatedly failed to finish, consuming the time available for the remaining tasks.

attributions.evidence: After the first timeout, Decision 8 selected EXPLORE living_room_1 again. The trace already recorded plate_0 at cabinet_5 with is_clean=false.
attributions.description: The planner kept retrying the same search while the confirmed plate task remained actionable, leaving both plate requirements unattempted at timeout.

attributions.evidence: Decisions 7–11 all selected EXPLORE living_room_1. After each completed attempt, the trace showed the same 13 particles, unchanged belief mass, and no additional inspected areas.
attributions.description: The planner repeated a search that yielded no new task-relevant information and did not switch to another pending subtask.

attributions.evidence: The initial goals included toy_truck_0 within wardrobe_2. The update after a1 dropped that goal, later updates introduced toy_car_0 and toy_block_0, and the a7 update recorded the real truck on floor_living_room_1 without restoring its goal.
attributions.description: The goal hypotheses failed to reconnect the observed truck to the instruction to put away all living-room toys. Speculative toy goals remained active during the repeated searches.

result.reasoning: After the stale plate pickup failed, the revised plan identified the correct toys and plate. The robot stored both toys and washed the plate, then tried four times to put it inside cabinet_5 despite feedback that the cabinet had no interior receptacle. It finally stored the plate in cabinet_0. The trace shows a18 directly enabled the truck's required placement.

attributions.evidence: The revised English plan said to place plate_0 inside cabinet_5. At a30, the simulator reported that cabinet_5 had no receptacle for 'within'.
attributions.description: The revised plan selected the sink cabinet for storage even though it could not contain the plate.

attributions.evidence: After a30 reported no interior receptacle, the PDDL planner regenerated the same four-action sequence for in(plate_0, cabinet_5).
attributions.description: The first retry kept the same destination after feedback established that the required placement was impossible there.

attributions.evidence: The retry sequence starting at a32 kept in(plate_0, cabinet_5) as its subgoal, and a40 returned the same no-receptacle error.
attributions.description: The unchanged retry plan carried the invalid destination into the third placement attempt.

attributions.evidence: The planner kept regenerating the same plan through a45 and switched to cabinet_0 only after the fourth failure.
attributions.description: The retry strategy delayed changing the destination and produced a fourth attempt at the same impossible placement.

attributions.evidence: The revised plan targeted toy_truck_0 on the living-room floor. The pickup at a18 supplied the truck for the successful placement inside wardrobe_2 at a22.
attributions.description: The trace provides no evidence of an underlying error that explains the flag on this pickup.

attributions.evidence: Immediately after the no-receptacle failure at a30, the trace repeats the same subgoal and identical navigate, open, navigate, and place plan.
attributions.description: The planner reused the full sequence after receiving feedback that required a different storage destination.
